statement: ∀ θ : ℝ, θ < 7/8 → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (θ+1/8+ε) / x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Fourier 选频 · TP-0017 · 给出微分均值容许的 7/8 严格阈值
plain_statement.en: New route · Fourier isolation · TP-0017 · Budget the strict seven-eighths threshold for the differentiated mean

brief.zh: 两条 Mellin 线共耗 1/8，除以 T 后选 ε；均值公式本身另需证明。
brief.en: Budget 1/8 for the two Mellin lines, divide by T and choose ε. The differentiated mean itself requires proof.
